item.title: Things that Have Worked for Our OSS Community
item.description: I’m the technical leader and founder of the “Critter Stack” tools (Marten, Polecat, Wolverine, and Weasel) and the greater JasperFx organization on GitHub. After 15+ years of OSS community work of varying degrees of technical and project adoption success, I’ve got a few things to share that I think have helped us be more successful. … Continue reading Things that Have Worked for Our OSS Community → Link to article: https://jeremydmiller.
